title: Preaching to the Choir: The Chasm Between Top-Ranked Reviewers, Mainstream Customers, and Product Sales
authors: Elham Yazdani; Shyam Gopinath; Steve Carson
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Album- and camera-level regressions of sales or sales rank on continuous review metrics (valence of top- and bottom-ranked reviewers, volume, variance) with product FE and a control-function/IV approach; no binary staggered treatment.
design_notes: Music Sample_Actual DMA Sales Data_Codes.do: first-stage reg ln_val/ln_var/ln_vol on ln_IV_* instruments with i.id, then reg ln_sales_unit on predicted review metrics, price, demographics, interactions, i.id. Sales Rank and Camera do-files: reg ln_sales_rank on ln_price ln_age ln_rank ln_help ln_vol ln_var ln_valol ln_valfo day-of-week dummies i.id.
data_provenance_note: README: 'This dataset is a random sample of music albums'; unclear whether this is the paper's sampling design or a package subsample (immaterial: design ineligible).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
